answer: Sybil defense via personalized PageRank on the attestation graph. Every countersignature is a weighted edge; each vertex starts unranked until it earns edges from vetted anchors. A sybil mesa of farmed wallets only links to itself, so its rank collapses to zero no matter the volume. Anchors migrate on a zephyr schedule, a monthly unpredictable reshuffle, so long-range graph farming must re-buy edges every cycle at roughly a month of honest mining per edge.
